The neon glow and hustle of Rockstar’s Vice City comes to NBA 2K27 in an extended, seven-week Season 3, running from November 27th through to January 15th. Vice City-inspired content and rewards span every corner of the Season experience, from a brand-new Vice City-inspired Park in The City - to themed apparel including Vice City and Los Santos jerseys, Burger Shot and Cluckin’ Bell Employee Outfits, and much more.

The Brotato Brigado DLC brings a new wizard, Spud, to the Brigade, along with Brotato-inspired spells, outfits and scrolls!

The Sinking Murk Update introduces a new swampy Realm full of infected monsters, plus many more features to discover.

Grab your friends and dive in!
